description: This PHP class 'EmpUsTaxExemptionController' manages the tax exemption view for employees within the OrangeHRM system, including setting up Vue components and permissions based on employee data.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionController
classes.description: Controller for managing employee US tax exemption view, extending BaseViewEmployeeController, handling component setup and permissions.

methods.name: getCountryService
methods.description: Returns the CountryService instance from the container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee tax exemption data and sets permissions; handles bad request if no employee number.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups required for capability permission checks, specifically 'tax_exemptions'.
